gameName: Marco Polo II: In the Service of the Khan
firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently returned from a journey starts and takes the first-player marker.
clarifications: Starting with that player, turns proceed clockwise.
The separate character draft begins with the last player and moves in reverse clockwise order.
A Travel action may change who begins a later round.
